svg.title: Simulated debris cloud spreading after a collision at 800 km, 74 deg
svg.desc: Illustrative, simplified; not a prediction. Fragment positions by right ascension and declination at 15 minutes, 1 day and 1 year. Numbers are in breakup_cloud.csv.
svg.text: Simulated collision at 800 km, 74 deg: fragments spread from a point to a ring to a shell
1,168 of 1,168 simulated fragments (10 cm and larger), two-body + J2 motion, no drag. Each dot is one fragment's position in the sky.
1 day: rings along both parents' orbits
x: right ascension 0-360 deg; y: declination -90 to +90 deg
